title: 2001 SCCM/ESICM/ACCP/ATS/SIS International Sepsis Definitions Conference
population_scope: Mixed/adult relevance to be checked; conference consensus paper
notes: Conference name refers to 2001 process; journal publication is 2003. PubMed classifies consensus statement and review; verify full text, methods and adult applicability before inclusion.

title: Surviving Sepsis Campaign guidelines for management of severe sepsis and septic shock
population_scope: adult scope to verify; source describes international expert guidance
notes: Parallel ICM publication exists (DOI 10.1007/s00134-004-2210-z; PMID 14997291). Check which full text is publicly readable and whether recommendations are separable for adults.

title: Surviving Sepsis Campaign: international guidelines for management of severe sepsis and septic shock: 2008
population_scope: adult guidance with paediatric considerations; separability to verify
issuing_organisations: SCCM; ESICM; International SSC Guidelines Committee
notes: Springer page labels article Open access; original guideline is available at PMC. Check licence and adult/paediatric separation. Do not confuse PMC correction PMCID PMC4969965 with the original guideline.

title: Surviving Sepsis Campaign: international guidelines for management of severe sepsis and septic shock
population_scope: adult guidance with paediatric subgroup; separability to verify
issuing_organisations: SCCM; ESICM; Surviving Sepsis Campaign Guidelines Committee
notes: The guideline is commonly labelled 2012, but the primary ICM paper was published online 2013-01-30 and in the 2013 issue. Parallel Critical Care Medicine publication DOI 10.1097/CCM.0b013e31827e83af, PMID 23353941. Do not create a duplicate edition.

title: Surviving Sepsis Campaign: international guidelines for management of sepsis and septic shock: 2016
population_scope: adult guidance; check primary full text
notes: Conventional edition label is 2016; ICM publication record is 2017. Parallel Crit Care Med publication DOI 10.1097/CCM.0000000000002255, PMID 28098591. Verify adult scope, full text and canonical citation.

title: The Third International Consensus Definitions for Sepsis and Septic Shock (Sepsis-3)
population_scope: adult-focused task force; verify document eligibility
notes: Separate consensus-definition document, not a treatment guideline. Direct critical-care relevance is strong; confirm eligibility under inclusion criteria. Companion septic-shock criteria paper DOI 10.1001/jama.2016.0289, PMID 26903335, PMCID PMC4910392 should be assessed as a related consensus publication rather than assumed duplicate.

title: Surviving sepsis campaign: international guidelines for management of sepsis and septic shock 2021
notes: Parallel Crit Care Med publication DOI 10.1097/CCM.0000000000005337, PMID 34605781. PMC page notes reuse permission conditional on WHO COVID-19 declaration; do not record as an unrestricted Creative Commons licence.

title: Surviving Sepsis Campaign: International Guidelines for Management of Sepsis and Septic Shock 2026
notes: SCCM official page reports publication 2026-03-23 and adult scope. Critical Care Medicine article is volume 54(4), pages 725-812, April 2026; a parallel Intensive Care Medicine publication is DOI 10.1007/s00134-026-08361-1, PMID 41870560. Existing master seed GCCG-000001 is related but remains pending second review and OA verification; reconcile before adding another record.

title: Suspected sepsis: recognition diagnosis and early management
population_scope: All-age guidance; adult recommendations to be screened separately
issuing_organisations: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
notes: NICE states NG51 was published 13 July 2016 and later updated; replaced by NG253/NG254/NG255 in 2025. Adult-only eligibility must be confirmed from the original guideline sections and adult age criterion.

title: Suspected sepsis in people aged 16 or over: recognition assessment and early management
population_scope: Age 16+; fails strict age_minimum=18 unless adult recommendations can be isolated
issuing_organisations: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
notes: NICE guideline published 2025-11-19; updated 2026-09-23, including PCT recommendations. Scope includes ages 16 and 17; do not include as adult-only without a defensible adult subgroup extraction. Replaces NG51 for this population.

title: S3 guideline on sepsis—prevention diagnosis therapy and follow-up care—update 2025
population_scope: Adult/paediatric scope to be checked in full guideline
issuing_organisations: German Sepsis Society and participating AWMF member societies
notes: AWMF register 079-001, version 4.0 dated 2025-04-30. Full text in German; PMC states CC BY 4.0. Confirm adult-only scope or separable adult recommendations, development method, and whether this update is a materially distinct edition.

title: The Japanese Clinical Practice Guidelines for Management of Sepsis and Septic Shock 2024
population_scope: Mixed adults and children; adult recommendations must be separable
issuing_organisations: Japanese Society of Intensive Care Medicine; Japanese Association for Acute Medicine
notes: Guideline edition is J-SSCG2024; English journal publication appeared 2025-02-24. The guideline targets adults and children, mainly ICU or equivalent; adult recommendations must be extracted separately. Parallel co-publication DOI 10.1186/s40560-025-00776-0 is same edition, not another record.

title: Early management of adult sepsis and septic shock: Korean clinical practice guidelines
issuing_organisations: Korean Sepsis Alliance; Korean Society of Critical Care Medicine
notes: Adult-specific guideline. De novo development and GRADE are described in the primary publication. Full text is available under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0; verify exact licence and guideline issuer/endorsement details.

title: Guidelines on the Clinical Management of Sepsis
population_scope: Adults and children; separable adult recommendations to be verified
notes: WHO states guideline supports adult and paediatric national programmes and covers early recognition, initial resuscitation and early treatment. Locate and inspect the full guideline document; WHO webpage is a launch page, not proof of full-text access or separability.

title: BC Initial Adult Sepsis Recognition and Management Guidelines
geographic_classification: Health Quality BC; Emergency Care BC; Critical Care BC
column23: Provincial British Columbia guideline; official page and PHSA identify the 2026 adult guidelines. Download and inspect the linked PDF, exact date/version, issuing governance and methodology before deciding eligibility. Distinguish from local hospital protocols.

title: Sepsis Clinical Care Standard
geographic_classification: Australian Commission on Safety and Quality in Health Care
column23: Screened out of the current CPG/consensus dataset: it is a national clinical care standard with quality statements/indicators, and the Commission explicitly says detailed sepsis management and clinical decisions are outside its scope. Retain in screening log for transparency; could be indexed in a separate standards collection.
